poses.caption: Lie on the side with straight legs stacked and head supported by the lower arm.
Lift both feet together while keeping legs straight, pause briefly, then lower slowly; finish repetitions and switch sides.

jobs.detail: SIDE-LYING BOTH-FEET RAISE, TWO equal SQUARE panels side by side same front-side three-quarter camera/model/scale, HEAD IMAGE LEFT FEET RIGHT. Lie on LEFT SIDE along thin gray mat, hips/waist and lower torso grounded BOTH phases, not a plank. LEFT bottom arm bent to support side of head in left hand, left elbow/upper arm rests mat, neck neutral; RIGHT top palm rests lightly mat in FRONT abdomen for balance. Both legs STRAIGHT and STACKED together, knees fully extended, ankles/shoes touching each other both phases. LEFT LOWER: both legs/shoes on mat. RIGHT LIFT: lift BOTH straight legs together about15-20cm off mat as ONE stacked pair, both shoes clearly off mat same height, thighs adducted together no gap between legs, no top-leg-only abduction, pelvis remains on LEFT SIDE mat, upper body/head supported same place. Same limb lengths/scale; no knee bend. Primary ADDUCTORS ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED red tint over INNER upper thigh area on intact opaque black shorts, no outer-hip red, no muscle lines through cloth. Fine exposed grayscale arms/calves. Head/arms/pelvis sameposition, no seated V-up. Full clothes front sides back seat crotch.

poses.caption: Stand tall, gently tilt one ear toward its shoulder while keeping the opposite shoulder down, and hold 20–30 seconds; return to center and switch sides.

jobs.detail: GENTLE SIDE NECK STRETCH, ONE static full-body standing hold REAR three-quarter view with enough face profile to show ear moving toward shoulder. Stand tall feet hip width, knees soft, torso vertical and pelvis level. Tilt head gently toward RIGHT shoulder about20degrees, RIGHT ear toward right shoulder; NO turning face/no forward neck flexion/no chin tuck, gaze forward. Keep LEFT shoulder relaxed pressed DOWN away from left ear, both arms relaxed at SIDES hands free, no forced hand traction needed. Shoulder line horizontal, no torso side bend/shrug. Primary LEFT LEVATOR SCAPULAE area teaching highlight on EXPOSED LEFT POSTEROLATERAL NECK from upper inner shoulder toward upper neck, small red elongated patch ONLY there, all other exposed muscles grayscale. Do not remove shirt fabric to expose deep muscle; opaque black shirt back covers torso and scapulae; patch stops at neckline if covered. Fine detailed grayscale anatomy on exposed arms/calves and neck, realistic relaxed proportions. Hair short or neatly tied away from back/side neck. Entire body head/shoes/hands inside generous white margins. No anatomy labels/text.
